title: Anyone can run a 5-minute Mindless session signed out, and is offered "same time tomorrow?" after it

source.ref: Frequency Launch Build Brief, owner, 2026-10-06; gap report /mnt/project-files/launch/2026-10-06-launch-sweep.md

detail: WORKSTREAM 8 of the launch brief (ADR-1720), "and 8 if there's room" before 1 December. TODAY: the timer is /on-air, a protected path (proxy.ts:61; LIVE-136 made it protected), so the Calm down fast funnel, whose first win is a 5-minute Mindless session, hits a sign-in wall. "Same time tomorrow" copy exists for members only (lib/on-air.ts:680). THE FIX: a public no-account browser timer and breathing pacer (client only, no writes, nothing sent to analytics beyond a generic page view) with the 5-minute practice preset, and after a session a "same time tomorrow?" offer that leads to signup with the time kept. LIVE-800's Calm down fast door lands here once it ships. Member-facing: help line and changelog entry. CLOSED 2026-10-06: app/(marketing)/mindless (page + public-timer.tsx): the Coherence pacer (BreathVisualizer, five in, five out) with one 5-minute clock, client only, no writes, no analytics event. At the end it asks "Same time tomorrow?" and links to /join?next=/on-air; the daily practice nudge then learns the hour from the member's own sessions (habitualHour, lib/practices/lifecycle.ts). Not in proxy PROTECTED_PATHS; in the sitemap. Help (how-to-calm-down-fast) and changelog updated. LIVE-800 points the Calm down fast door here.
